verdict.rationale: Kit MCP explicitly exposes subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, and segments to AI clients, and the API supports broadcast stats (opens, clicks, unsubscribes), link click performance, custom fields, and account data — enabling an agent to pull audiences, automations, and campaign results and report on performance. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of an agent actually performing this end-to-end report, and explicit API/MCP coverage of live automation workflow details beyond tags/segments.
